create_chatglm_config: create a ChatGLMConfig instance with transformer architecture parameters like layers, attention heads, and hidden size
build_chatglm_model: build a ChatGLMModel with embeddings, rotary positional encoding, and transformer encoder for text encoding
run_self_attention: run self-attention with query key value projection, rotary embedding, kv cache, and multi-query attention support
apply_rotary_position_embedding: apply rotary position embedding to query and key tensors for positional encoding in transformer layers
run_glm_transformer: run a GLMTransformer with stacked GLMBlocks, RMSNorm, attention masks, and kv cache for inference
